notes.title: New interaction
notes.content:
- F key use to interact with object (open door/chest storage)
- F key use to pickup item on ground

- Mouse left use player equiped item on target
- Hotbar 5 slots to quickly equip or unequip items

- New food icon cookie color
- Some machines internal inventory now use ui item storage.
- More machines receive a name and properly show info and ALT-info.

- Sitting on any bench heal player, toilet randomly cure

notes.title: Splitting snow!
notes.content:
- Changed the way building react to avalanches.
- Now snow from avalanche is split in chunk, better have a shovel.

notes.title: Let's break doors!
notes.content:
- Now doors can be break with items (shovel).
- Added equiped item control/use.
  You can now equip tool in hand and use it with mouse leftclick.
  Easier to dig and break windows/doors.
- New equipable tool (shovel, wrench, knife).
- Update some items description.
- Add texture to fuel item.
- Some machines receive a name and properly show info and ALT-info.

notes.title: Something new!
notes.content:
- Item storage must be empty to be pickup and now show its own temp and the total item temp inside.
- New crafting machine that need power to operate.
- Add camera shake when avalanches are close.
- New inventory craft recipe. Select 2 woods, 1 fuel, 1 signal rocket and drag them on the ground to create wild fire.
  You can fuel fire by adding more wood in it, just drag it from inventory onto the fire.
  This help to unfreeze door/windows/...

notes.title: First step in home protection!
notes.content:
- Can now move when storage is open, it will close when you move away.
  You will feel less stuck!
- New item avalanche neutralizer, if avalanches come close it will neutralize it!
  Neutralizer disappear in the process.

notes.title: Achieve this!
notes.content:
- Craft machine properly update resource list.
- Added 6 clothes recipe at bench.
- Added fake master key recipe ;)
- 6 new achievements.
- Death menu more accurate time when load save.
- Avalanches snow can be digged.
- Add cable item missing material.

notes.title: Where was the house?
notes.content:
- Add building not present O_o

- Update dropdown to fit long name
- Change gas station fuel tank for underground fuel tank

- Change snow filling house model
- Change some others models
- Remove item info menu, now item detail is in tooltip when holding left alt
- Storage tooltip show temp of item inside

notes.title: More info...
notes.content:

- Added extended tooltip info when holding left alt key

notes.content:
